title: ChatGPT Reached 100 Million Users In 2 Months
hook: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in 2 months.
closing: That speed let one service shape global AI habits before rivals caught up.
question: Was that adoption too fast?

segments.say: ChatGPT reached 900 million active users. The early rush became a lasting global habit.
ChatGPT reached its milestone in 2 months. The old app-adoption timeline collapsed.
ChatGPT serves 850 million free users. Mass adoption creates huge costs before most people pay.
